name: Mutants Arrival
summary: This is Steve, split down the middle. One half is still human, but the other half answers to the mobs...
legend: Nobody knows what fell from the sky that night, only that Steve walked out of the crater split straight down the middle. His left side was still himself: brown hair, blue eye, blue shirt, worn grey trousers. His right side belonged to something else. In the first village he was Steve x Enderman, half black void with violet sparks for eyes. By the next sunrise a pale, bone-white Steve x Skeleton was rattling through the forest. Then the shepherds swore they saw Steve x Blaze, one half burning gold, leaving scorch marks across their fields. Every copy has the same calm blue eye on the human side. Every copy is missing a little more of the man. The mutants keep arriving, and the crater has not gone quiet yet...

skins.name: Steve x Enderman
skins.story: The first to crawl from the crater, half Steve and half pitch-black Enderman, with violet sparks glittering in his void-dark eye.

skins.name: Steve x Skeleton
skins.story: His right side was stripped down to bone-white ribs and hollow black sockets, and he rattles softly when he walks.

skins.name: Steve x Enderdragon
skins.story: Dark purple scales, a glowing violet eye and pale claws: the End itself seems to have claimed half of this Steve.

versions.note: The crater opens: Steve x Enderman, Steve x Skeleton and the violet-eyed Steve x Enderdragon walk out of the dark.

skins.name: Steve x Pig
skins.story: A pink, snouted half that the farmers swear grunts in its sleep, and yes, it still loves carrots.

skins.name: Steve x Slime
skins.story: His bright green half wobbles like jelly, and the hollow dark eyes inside it never seem to blink.

skins.name: Steve x Chicken
skins.story: White feathers, a red comb, a yellow beak and orange feet, and he still clucks whenever the sun rises.

versions.note: The mutation reaches the overworld: pink Steve x Pig, wobbling Steve x Slime and feathered Steve x Chicken join the arrivals.

skins.name: Steve x Cow
skins.story: Black-and-white patches spread across his body, a pink muzzle grew in, and nobody dares to milk him.

skins.name: Steve x Creeper
skins.story: A mottled green half with a black, frowning face, and a quiet hiss follows him everywhere.

skins.name: Steve x Baby Chicken
skins.story: The smallest mutation: a fluffy bright-yellow half with a tiny orange beak and orange feet that patter close behind you.

skins.name: Steve x Sheep
skins.story: Cream-white wool on one side, a tan face peeking out, and the shears always seem to go missing near him.

versions.note: The farms are not safe anymore. Steve x Cow, Steve x Creeper, the tiny Steve x Baby Chicken and woolly Steve x Sheep have been spotted.

skins.name: Steve x Zombie
skins.story: The green rot is still spreading, dripping across his blue shirt as one undead arm reaches forward.

skins.name: Steve x Blaze
skins.story: Half of him burns a molten gold and orange, and the grass he walks on never grows back.

skins.name: Steve x Fox
skins.story: An orange-furred half with a white muzzle and black paws, slipping between the trees before you can follow.

versions.note: Rot, fire and fur: Steve x Zombie, the burning Steve x Blaze and the sly Steve x Fox arrive, and the crater is still not quiet.

versions.title: Webs, Iron and Echoes

skins.name: Steve x Spider
skins.story: His dark, bristly half clings to the cave walls at night, and a cluster of red eyes watches you even when the human eye is closed.

skins.name: Steve x Iron Golem
skins.story: Half of him turned to heavy, vine-wrapped iron, and the villagers sleep easy now because he still carries a red poppy for every child he guards.

skins.name: Steve x Warden
skins.story: He came up from the deep dark without a left eye at all, and the souls trapped in his chest glow brighter every time you make a sound.

versions.note: The crater reaches deeper: Steve x Spider climbs out of the caves, Steve x Iron Golem stomps in from the village, and the blind Steve x Warden rises from the deep dark.

logoPrompt: Square logo, a single blocky Minecraft-style figure split vertically down the middle: left half classic Steve with brown hair, blue eye, blue shirt and grey trousers; right half Ender Dragon with dark purple-black scales, a glowing violet eye, speckled purple glow across the body and pale bone-white horns and claws. Dramatic violet rim light and purple particles, deep dark background, no text.
coverPrompt: Wide cinematic cover, three blocky Minecraft-style figures standing side by side, each split vertically down the middle, left half classic Steve (brown hair, blue eye, blue shirt, grey trousers). Left figure: right half Enderman, pitch black with glowing purple eyes and violet specks. Middle figure: right half mottled green Creeper with a black face. Right figure: right half Blaze, burning golden-yellow and orange with a fiery glow. Background: a smoking crater at night under a strange purple sky, with drifting embers and ender particles. Big stylised blocky title text "MUTANTS ARRIVAL" across the top.
